      vanityName

      isEmailVerified
      isPhoneVerified
      isIdentityVerified
      isOnCommissionsProgram
      availableWalletBalance {
        amount
        currency
        __typename

      hasAcceptedCommissionsAgreement
      hasAcceptedStoresAgreement
      phone
      avatarUrl
      createdAt
      isAdmin
      clientRegion
      teams {
        active
        artworkIds
        isApprover
        becomeId
        becomeName
        becomePath
        becomeAvatar
        teamId
        canSavePaymentMethod
        creditLimit
        creditAvailable
        domainName
        vanityName
        __typename
      }
      websiteUrl
      storeCredit
      __typename
    }
    refId
    __typename
  }
}"}
